title: Refund window
text: Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery. After 30 days, only faulty items are refundable. The refund is issued to the original payment method.

title: Duplicate charges
text: A duplicate charge is reversed within 5 business days once confirmed. No return is required and no further action is needed from the customer.

title: Damaged items
text: If an item arrives damaged or broken, ask for a photo and refund in full including shipping. No return is required for damage under the value of 50.

title: Partial refunds
text: A partial refund cannot exceed the captured amount. The difference may be issued as account credit if the original payment method is no longer valid.

title: Tracking updates
text: Tracking updates can lag 24 hours. If no update appears after four days, open an investigation with the courier and tell the customer the case reference.

title: Lost parcels
text: A parcel that has not arrived after ten business days is treated as lost. Replace it or refund it in full, whichever the customer prefers.

title: Address changes
text: A delivery address can be changed before dispatch. After dispatch the courier must be contacted, and a redirect fee may apply.

title: Delivery estimates
text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days. Express takes 1 to 2. Estimates are working days and exclude public holidays.

title: Invoice corrections
text: An incorrect invoice is reissued within 2 business days under the same number. The original invoice is voided automatically.

title: VAT and receipts
text: A VAT receipt is available for any order in the last 12 months from the billing page. A receipt can also be resent by email on request.

title: Failed payments
text: A declined card is retried on days 1, 3 and 7. If all attempts fail the subscription is paused and the customer is notified.

title: Currency and conversion
text: Charges are made in the account currency. Conversion differences applied by the card issuer are not refunded.

title: Password reset
text: A reset link expires after 30 minutes. If it does not arrive, check the spam folder and request a new link once.

title: Changing the email
text: Changing the account email requires confirming the new address. The old address is released only after confirmation.

title: Two-factor authentication
text: Two-factor codes are delivered by SMS or an authenticator app. A lost device requires a recovery code issued at setup.

title: Account lockout
text: Five failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes. Support can unlock it after identity verification.

title: Cancellation timing
text: A cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Access continues until that date and no partial refund is issued.

title: Data deletion
text: Account deletion removes personal data within 30 days. Billing records are retained for 7 years as required by tax law.

title: Auto-renew
text: Auto-renew can be switched off at any time from the plan settings. Switching it off does not shorten the current period.

title: Cancelling an order
text: An unshipped order can be cancelled for a full refund before dispatch. After dispatch it must be returned instead.

title: API access
text: A public API is available on the pro plan. Rate limits are 600 requests per minute and the documentation is public.

title: Discounts
text: Student and nonprofit discounts are available on request with verification. The discount applies to the annual plan only.

title: Support hours
text: Support is staffed Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 UTC. Outside those hours only billing incidents are answered.

title: Data export
text: All account data can be exported as CSV or JSON from the settings page. The export is available immediately.
